teacher_decision: Do not add a special handoff controller yet; first test a support-buffer handoff as a high-level composition of existing generic tools.
observed_gap: The planned right-to-left regrasp was not IK-feasible for the left arm at the selected buffer. Qwen recovered without a new task-specific tool: after changing the blue block pose at the buffer, it re-grasped with the right arm and the generic yaw-search placement planner found a right-arm solution over the green support.
conclusion: A high-level task policy composed from reusable perception, grasp, and placement tools was sufficient to turn Qwen0's no-motion failure into a native RoboTwin success. The remaining weakness is recovery-policy reliability: the model deviated from the requested arm handoff, but the bounded generic planners kept the recovery grounded and legal.
